# Purpose
This R Markdown document outlines the automated data cleaning pipeline for synthetic sales records[cite: 3].

## Inputs
* `raw_sales_data.csv`: Raw synthetic transaction logs containing transaction dates and revenues[cite: 3].

## Code & Execution
```{r cleaning}
library(dplyr)
raw_data <- data.frame(
  Date = c("2026-01-01", "2026-01-02"),
  Revenue = c(1200, 1500)
)
clean_data <- raw_data %>% mutate(Date = as.Date(Date))
head(clean_data)
